The <b>Rosary Cannon</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It fires [[Rosaries]] as a projectile.

== Usefulness ==
When pressing the [[Controls (Silksong)|SKILL/TOOL]] input, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] stands still to pull out the Rosary Cannon and begins firing after a short delay. As long as the input is held, the cannon fires automatically at a rate of roughly 10 [[Rosaries]] per second, stopping immediately when the input is released or the cannon runs out of Rosaries. 

Hornet must stand in place while firing the cannon, and its recoil will slowly push her backwards. Hornet can turn around while firing, briefly firing diagonally upwards and overhead as she changes direction, but this does not allow it to function as a respectable weapon for aerial [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] since it is impossible to control. Each Rosary deals 1 of 2 damage values at random. 

A small amount of Rosaries may be dropped and collected again after they have been fired from the Rosary Cannon.

* The Rosary Cannon has a high maximum capacity, but due to the small damage per Rosary, it only deals an average amount of total damage.
* {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} that are replenished using [[Shell Shards]] universally cost 80 shards to refill from empty. Hornet can buy [[Shard Bundle]]s, consumable items that grant 80 Shell Shards, from various vendors across [[Pharloom]] for 50 Rosaries. However, the Rosary Cannon requires 80 Rosaries to refill. This makes it the most expensive {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} to reload, 60% more than others.
* Hornet cannot reload the cannon when she respawns at a bench, due to losing all of her Rosaries upon death. This drawback can be mitigated by having the [[Dead Bug's Purse]] equipped, using [[Rosary String|Rosary Strings]], or consuming a [[Silkeater]].
* Unlike other [[Tools]], the Rosary Cannon is not replenished automatically. It must be manually loaded while resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] by selecting it in the inventory and holding the [[Controls (Silksong)|ATTACK]] input.
** Due to this, it is unable to be reloaded by the [[Architect Crest]]'s Craft Bind.

== How to Acquire ==
Found behind a breakable wall inside of the [[High Halls#Rosary Bank|Rosary Bank]] in [[High Halls]], just west of the [[Ventrica]] station. A [[Simple Key (Silksong)|Simple Key]] is required to open the room.

When the mechanism in the room below the [[Rosary]] stringing machine is broken by hitting it with the [[Needle]], it drops the [[Tool]] as a collectible.

== Trivia ==
* Rosary Cannon is made from the mechanism of a Rosary stringing machine, which can be used before acquiring it. After the Rosary Cannon has been acquired, the machine will no longer be usable.
** Its capacity is likely in reference to the machines costing {{R|80}} to operate.
* The concept may be based on [[wikipedia:Rotary cannon|rotary cannons]] due to its similar name and function.
* The Rosary Cannon has a unique text prompt for trying to reload it without a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]]: <i>"Reload Tools while resting at a bench."</i> It uses the same icon as trying to change [[Tools]] without a Bench.
